title: Air Force son returns from deployment, surprises his Coast Guard father
description: ST.PETERSBURG, Fla.— Coast Guard Chief Petty Officer John Hamilton, the dining facility food service officer at Air Station Clearwater, Florida, reunited with his son, Air Force Senior Airman Julian Hamilton, a fuel systems journeyman in the 5th Reconnaissance Squadron at Osan Air Base, South Korea, Thursday, May 22, 2014 at Air Station Clearwater. Julian Hamilton surprised his father upon returning from a six month deployment. U.S. Coast Guard video by Seaman Meredith Manning. Available in high definition.
